newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firms show Jan-Oct PLN 9.0 bln net profit.
newsitem.headline: Polish firms show Jan-Oct PLN 9.0 bln net profit.

text.p: Polish enterprises reported an overall 9.0 billion zloty net profit in the January-October period, compared with a 8.7 billion zloty net profit in the same period of 1995, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.

GUS said the private sector had a net profit of 5.4 billion zlotys on total revenues of 228.5 billion in the period against a profit of 3.3 billion and revenues of 142.9 billion in the same period last year.
The state-owned sector reported a profit of 3.7 billion on sales of 219.9 billion versus last year's 5.4 billion and 192.0 billion respectively.
NOTES: Data collected from all companies employing more than 50 people in main sectors of the economy.
Liquidity ratio is a percentage relation of cash reserves and tradable securities to short-term liabilities.
